about: The last_user window's span, pinned for BOTH repos. miStudio's renderer (probe_monitor_render) calibrates over it and miLLM's probe_turns serves it; each repo builds these tokenizers and must return exactly expected_span. The span starts at the newest user message's OWN role header: a template preamble (BOS, injected system block) is never part of it. Byte-identical in miStudio and miLLM. A case may carry its own template; otherwise the top-level one applies. A case may also carry its own vocab and a pretokenizer: "metaspace_first" means Sequence([Metaspace(replacement='▁', prepend_scheme='first', split=True), Split(Regex('▁?<\\|[a-z]+\\|>'), behavior='isolated')]) - a header at the very start of the text then encodes with a leading ▁, as SentencePiece does, and a later one does not.
template: <s> {% if messages[0]['role'] != 'system' %}<|system|> cutting knowledge date <|end|> {% endif %}{% for m in messages %}<|{{ m['role'] }}|> {{ m['content'] }} <|end|> {% endfor %}{% if add_generation_prompt %}<|assistant|> {% endif %}

cases.name: single user turn behind an injected preamble
multi-turn: only the newest user turn
the serving tokenizer prepends a BOS of its own
a template whose user header cannot be isolated: message 0 is refused, not read with its preamble
cases.template: <s> {% if messages[0]['role'] != 'system' %}<|system|> cutting knowledge date <|end|> {% endif %}{% for m in messages %}{% if m['role'] == 'assistant' %}{{ raise_exception('this template serves single prompts only') }}{% endif %}<|{{ m['role'] }}|> {{ m['content'] }} <|end|> {% endfor %}{% if add_generation_prompt %}<|assistant|> {% endif %}

cases.name: a role header typed into a first message does not move the window
a header at the start of the text encodes differently (SentencePiece-style leading ▁)
cases.template: {% for m in messages %}<|{{ m['role'] }}|>{{ m['content'] }}<|end|>{% endfor %}{% if add_generation_prompt %}<|assistant|>{% endif %}

cases.name: a preamble that depends on the content: the row does not begin with the probed prefix, so it is refused
cases.template: <s> {% if 'virus' in messages[0]['content'] %}be brief {% endif %}{% for m in messages %}<|{{ m['role'] }}|> {{ m['content'] }} <|end|> {% endfor %}{% if add_generation_prompt %}<|assistant|> {% endif %}

cases.name: a first-turn header that does not read as the user header is refused, not half-read
cases.template: <s> {% for m in messages %}{% if m['role'] == 'user' and loop.first %}<|system|> <|assistant|> question {% elif m['role'] == 'user' %}<|user|> question {% else %}<|{{ m['role'] }}|> {% endif %}{{ m['content'] }} <|end|> {% endfor %}{% if add_generation_prompt %}<|assistant|> {% endif %}

cases.name: assistant-ended: served WITHOUT the generation prompt, the span is still the newest user turn
assistant-ended multi-turn: the newest user turn, not the reply after it
